svg.title: WP-S-02 Figure 2-1: envelope parameters
svg.desc: Envelope parameters: P-01 Longitudinal margin beyond the safe distance: 0.5 m, the margin of SG-01 (proposed, WP-S-04 §2); P-02 Lateral margin to a road user, obstacle or kerb: 0.3 m, the margin of SG-04 (proposed, WP-S-04 §2); P-03 Creep distance from standstill: 0.2 m, the margin of SG-05 (proposed, WP-S-04 §2); P-04 Drift allowed under remote driving: 1 m, the margin of SG-08 (proposed, WP-S-04 §2); P-05 Firm deceleration level for unconfirmed braking, and for the monitor's own stop: 3 m/s² (DQ-033 A); P-06 Assumptions of the safe longitudinal distance (response time, own guaranteed braking, braking of the vehicle ahead): The item responds within 0.5 s and can always brake at 4 m/s²; the vehicle ahead may brake at up to 8 m/s², which keeps 19.5 m at 50 km/h (DQ-034 A); P-07 Bounds on other road users' speed and acceleration, for crossing paths and occlusions (DQ-017 A): Pedestrians may run at up to 3 m/s and cyclists ride at up to 8 m/s, including out of an occlusion (DQ-034 A); P-08 Silence after which the vehicle stops on its own: 179 ms to 283 ms, the detection budget of SM-14 (WP-S-04 §4); P-09 Age bound of a remote command: 143 ms, the detection budget of SM-05 (WP-S-04 §4); P-10 Steering angle and rate envelope over speed: The chosen vehicle's steering geometry and actuator (DQ-008); P-11 Tolerances of achieved against commanded acceleration, deceleration and steering: The chosen vehicle's actuator response (DQ-008), set above its measured fault-free spread; P-12 Smallest object the safety channel must detect, and its detection range: Range is the stopping distance at the top ODD speed; the smallest height is set with FM-03; P-13 Allowed rate of false detections in the swept path, per sensor: The share of AC-02 allotted to unjustified monitor braking (WP-V-02), split across LiDAR and radar (DQ-031 A).
